hook.text: Apple's first logo was Newton under a tree. Its launch ad referenced 1984. Brands speak in myth.

buildup.text: Nike is the Greek goddess of victory. Amazon is the world's largest river. Naming is spell-casting.

discovery.text: Brands create origin myths: garage startups, visionary founders, against-all-odds stories.

twist.text: Consumers don't buy products. They buy into myths of identity, belonging, and transformation.

climax.text: Marketing hijacked mythmaking. The same archetypes that built religions now sell sneakers.

punchline.text: The temple moved to the mall.

quiz.question: Nike is named after a figure from which mythology?
